title: Task card
description: The filecards representation of a task on the seed-state ref (tasks/<id>.md frontmatter; the body is the work order: untrusted input AND a work order, D1). Bookkeeping blocks are written only by the shim as defined side effects of verbs. Trust: exactly as trustworthy as state-ref push access (R10); load-bearing gates ground on the default branch instead.

id.description: Hash-based id, never a sequential counter (D1)

squad.description: Explicit routing; otherwise priority-ordered scope matching, else core (§6)

blocked_on.description: Normative, shim-written, multi-valued (D1): every unblock path removes only its own entry; blocked→ready fires only when this empties.

author.description: Implementer of record: written by the shim when a claim ends at review submission (in_progress→review); the target of append_rejected_author on reject.

rejected_authors.description: Appended on reject (review→ready); claim refuses these actors. Untouched by release and reap.

claim.description: Present iff state is in_progress (§7.1: no other state ever carries a claim).

reviewer.description: Operator identity; for no-PR closes, the server-attributed dispatch actor (D7)

evidence.description: Merged PR URL, or for no-PR closes the dispatch-run/comment URL that is the card's evidence record (D7 exemption)

plan_hash.description: Advisory cache only: the authority is the merge-base blob (D3)
